description: Check whether a domain is registered, plus scan common typo-squat variants (adjacent-key substitution, letter omission/doubling, transposition) across popular TLDs (.com, .net, .org, .io, .co, .ai, .app, .dev) for brand-protection or domain-flipping research. WHOIS-based; capped at 40 variants checked per call for latency.
